objective: Use Logo.png as the browser tab and site icon, including the default favicon route.
definitionOfDone: Fireworks use vivid six-color palettes and randomize among classic radial, ring, star, chrysanthemum, and willow shapes with inspectable shape, region, source, motion, palette, center, extent, and lifecycle datasets.
Shape-aware left, center, upper, and right open-sky regions avoid the measured header/logo and progress overlays plus the school wings, tower, flag, hillside, and viewport clipping.
Key 1 remains one transient manual firework outside editable controls, ignores Ctrl/Meta/Alt and repeats, prevents default only when handled, and announces exactly "Firework launched.".

Key 2 toggles continuous fireworks outside editable controls, ignores Ctrl/Meta/Alt and repeats, prevents default only when handled, and announces exactly "Continuous fireworks started." or "Continuous fireworks stopped.".
Continuous mode uses one self-scheduling randomized 350-1100ms timeout, sometimes launches a pair, exposes scheduler state, is idempotent on start, and caps active fireworks at 14.
Stopping continuous mode cancels its pending timeout immediately without removing active bursts, and automatic bursts never change the live-region announcement.
Continuous scheduling pauses while the document is hidden, resumes when visible while enabled, and pagehide/unload cleanup cancels scheduling and clears active effects.
Reduced motion uses a simplified opacity fade, 900-1700ms scheduling, and at most one launch per scheduler tick.
Fireworks remain decorative/non-focusable and do not change donation state, persistent kite count, or the scene description.
Space kites, F fullscreen-only behavior, Pakistan flag, hillside swings, TCF School Seattle, Logo.png, donation progression, and offline dependency-free behavior remain present.
Visible keyboard hints and README document the key 2 continuous-fireworks toggle.
src/app.mjs and src/render.mjs pass node --check and /, /index.html, /styles.css, /src/app.mjs, /src/render.mjs, and /Logo.png return HTTP 200 from a local server that is stopped after verification.

A local headless Chromium browser exercises shortcut exclusions, shape and region datasets, pair launches, scheduler start/stop, visibility handling, bounded active nodes, reduced motion, cleanup, and preserved scene behavior.
